item.text: I found the failure in `inlineTokens`: it masks backslash-escaped punctuation across the whole line before masking code spans. That treats a backslash immediately before a code span’s closing backtick as escaping that delimiter in the emphasis-scanning copy, so the later emphasis markers are hidden inside what looks like an unterminated code span. I’m correcting the mask order so code spans are isolated first.

Fixed the inline masking order in [Lexer.ts](/C:/Users/USER/Downloads/agent-test/limit/codex_t6t3_r4/work/src/Lexer.ts:390): code spans are masked before escaped punctuation, so a literal backslash inside a code span can’t hide its closing backtick from emphasis parsing.
